programmes.name_local: Đề án 844 - Hỗ trợ hệ sinh thái khởi nghiệp đổi mới sáng tạo quốc gia
programmes.name_en: National Programme 844 for Supporting the Innovative Startup Ecosystem
programmes.funder: Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ (Ministry of Science and Technology)
programmes.amount_note: State budget support channelled mainly to ecosystem-building organisations (incubators, accelerators, universities, training providers) rather than directly to startups. Individual task funding is set per approved task within the annual programme budget.
programmes.deadline_note: Annual call for proposals for programme tasks, announced by the Ministry of Science and Technology, usually with a submission window in the middle of the year for the following year's tasks.
programmes.reopen_note: Programme 844 has been extended by successive Prime Ministerial decisions and continues to issue annual task calls. Startups typically benefit indirectly through supported incubators and accelerators rather than by applying directly.

procedure_steps.detail: Monitor the Ministry of Science and Technology and the National Startup Portal for the annual task call.
Prepare the task proposal (usually as an organisation, not an individual startup).
Submit to the programme management office.

eligibility.other_note: Applicants are normally Vietnamese organisations supporting the startup ecosystem. Startups benefit through the supported intermediaries.

programmes.source_snippet: Đề án 844 hỗ trợ phát triển hệ sinh thái khởi nghiệp đổi mới sáng tạo quốc gia.

programmes.name_local: Quỹ Đổi mới công nghệ quốc gia (NATIF)
programmes.funder: Quỹ Đổi mới công nghệ quốc gia, Bộ Khoa học và Công nghệ
programmes.amount_note: Provides non-refundable grants (typically covering a share of project cost, with higher shares for SMEs), preferential loans and interest rate support for technology transfer, technology innovation and R&D projects by Vietnamese enterprises. Amounts are set per approved project.
programmes.deadline_note: Calls for proposals are announced periodically on the NATIF website with defined submission windows.
programmes.reopen_note: NATIF issues new calls as its annual budget is allocated. Monitor natif.vn for the current call; the fund's operating regulations were revised in recent years, expanding the non-refundable grant share for SMEs.

procedure_steps.detail: Check natif.vn for an open call and the applicable support form (grant, loan or interest support).
Prepare the project dossier including technology description and financial plan.
Appraisal by an expert council and financial due diligence.
Contract signing and disbursement against milestones.

documents_required.doc: Technology transfer contract or IP documentation
Bank guarantee or collateral for loan support

eligibility.other_note: Vietnamese-registered enterprises undertaking technology innovation, technology transfer or R&D. Priority is given to SMEs and to projects in prioritised technology fields.

programmes.source_snippet: Quỹ Đổi mới công nghệ quốc gia hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp thực hiện đổi mới công nghệ, chuyển giao công nghệ và nghiên cứu phát triển.

programmes.name_local: Trung tâm Đổi mới sáng tạo Quốc gia (NIC)
programmes.funder: Trung tâm Đổi mới sáng tạo Quốc gia, Bộ Tài chính (formerly Ministry of Planning and Investment)
programmes.amount_note: Provides facilities at NIC Hoa Lac and Hanoi, incentives for tenant innovation businesses (including corporate income tax and land incentives under Decree 94), accelerator programmes run with corporate and international partners, and talent and investor matchmaking. Cash grants come through partner programmes rather than NIC directly.
programmes.deadline_note: Tenancy and partnership enquiries are rolling. Individual accelerator programmes run by NIC with partners have their own application windows.

procedure_steps.detail: Review the NIC programmes and facility offering.
Submit an enquiry or apply to a specific NIC partner accelerator programme.
Assessment and, for tenancy, negotiation of the facility agreement.
Apply separately for the innovation-business incentives where eligible.

documents_required.doc: Application for innovation business recognition for tax incentives

eligibility.other_note: Vietnamese innovative startups and technology companies. Some NIC programmes are open to foreign companies establishing a Vietnamese presence.

programmes.source_snippet: Trung tâm Đổi mới sáng tạo Quốc gia hỗ trợ hệ sinh thái đổi mới sáng tạo và khởi nghiệp của Việt Nam.

programmes.name_local: Hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp nhỏ và vừa khởi nghiệp sáng tạo (Nghị định 80/2021/NĐ-CP)
programmes.name_en: Support for Innovative Startup SMEs under Decree 80/2021
programmes.funder: Bộ Tài chính / Ủy ban nhân dân cấp tỉnh (Ministry of Finance and provincial People's Committees)
programmes.amount_note: Statutory support entitlements for innovative startup SMEs including partial reimbursement of consultancy, IP registration, technology transfer, testing and certification costs, and support for participation in accelerators and trade fairs. Support percentages and per-item caps are set in Decree 80/2021/ND-CP and administered locally, so the practical amount depends on the province's annual budget.
programmes.deadline_note: Applications are made to the provincial Department of Finance / Department of Planning and Investment. Availability depends on each province's annual budget allocation, so support may be exhausted mid-year.
programmes.reopen_note: This is a standing statutory entitlement rather than a round-based grant, but provincial budgets reset each calendar year. If a province has exhausted its allocation, reapply after the new budget is approved.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm the company qualifies as an innovative startup SME under Decree 80/2021.
Identify the specific support item (consultancy, IP, testing, accelerator participation, trade fairs).
Prepare and submit the dossier to the provincial authority or designated support agency.
Reimbursement on submission of invoices and completion evidence.

documents_required.doc: Evidence of innovative startup status (IP, technology, awards or investment)
Contracts and invoices for the supported activity

eligibility.other_note: Vietnamese SMEs meeting the innovative startup criteria in Decree 80/2021/ND-CP: operating for not more than five years from first business registration, not yet listed, and producing a new product or business model based on technology or intellectual property.

programmes.source_snippet: Nghị định 80/2021/NĐ-CP quy định chi tiết các nội dung hỗ trợ doanh nghiệp nhỏ và vừa khởi nghiệp sáng tạo.
